description: This test file contains unit tests for UI script functions related to Windows command shell behavior, focusing on whether the shell should be used for command execution and validating the safety of forwarded command-line arguments on different platforms.

methods.name: shouldUseShellForCommand
methods.description: Determines if the shell should be used for launching a command based on the command path and platform.

methods.name: assertSafeWindowsShellArgs
methods.description: Validates that forwarded command-line arguments are safe to use with shell mode on Windows platforms.
